name: Bloodlines: The Oracle's Gambit
source:
Punching holes in the fabric of spacetime has consequences, and it's the Oracle's job to sort it out, and overcome the opposing force led by the Null. At least, that's the normal course of events. The new Oracle has plans to do things differently...

[From [url=https://seedyaitch.itch.io/bloodlines-the-oracles-gambit]itch.io[/url]]
